SIDE LETTER dated as of May 1, 2026 to the Credit Agreement dated as of January 15, 2026 (as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated as of April 1, 2026), among Cedar Valley Robotics, Inc., as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Pioneer Mutual Bank, as Administrative Agent.

SECTION 1. Agreement . Notwithstanding Section 7.01(b) of the Credit Agreement, the Borrower agrees that it shall not incur other Indebtedness under Section 7.01(b) of the Credit Agreement in an aggregate principal amount exceeding $15,000,000 at any time outstanding.

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This letter shall become effective on May 1, 2026.
